create.name: Ariel Tang
create.bio:
Ariel Tang left a career in economics and finance for a life of teaching, and has taught yoga since 2009. She is an E-RYT 500 with Yoga Alliance, a certified Jivamukti teacher and a yoga teacher trainer. She has also trained as a Reiki Master Teacher and in Chi Nei Tsang, the Daoist abdominal massage. She assisted Jivamukti co-founders Sharon Gannon and David Life, served on the faculty of the Evolution Asia Yoga Conference, and was a lululemon ambassador for Hong Kong. Her work has appeared in Harper's Bazaar and Hong Kong Tatler. She is a certified White Tiger instructor in Five Element Qigong, and lists Tevia Feng and Mantak Chia among her teachers.

Her own work is now openly spiritual. She describes herself as an ascension mentor and trance channel, and offers private mentorship, light-language activations, Blue Lotus ceremonies, group programmes and sacred journeys, including a 2026 pilgrimage to Egypt. She is based in Bali and travels internationally to lead retreats and trainings. Her sessions mix lineages freely and keep a strong sense of joy.
